remarks: Welcome to this charming and completely updated Compo Beach cottage. Ideally located along prestigious Compo Road South, readily accessible to everything Westport has to offer - walk or bike to the train, Longshore Country Club, or Compo Beach. Inside this unexpectedly spacious home, you'll find three finished levels of living space. A vestibule with coat closet welcomes you into the large ground-level family room, complete with built-in cabinetry and a wood-burning stove. A laundry room with storage completes this floor. Upstairs, the main level offers a sun-filled living room and a sitting room/office overlooking the front lawn. A dining room with built-ins leads to an updated kitchen with new appliances and direct access to the backyard. The primary bedroom, renovated, full bath, and sitting/dressing room round out this level, featuring refinished hardwood floors and high ceilings. A second staircase leads to two additional bedrooms with closet/storage space and continued hardwood floors. Ceiling heights continue to surprise! The entire home has been freshly painted and upgraded with new lighting fixtures. The fenced backyard offers privacy, with well-established perennial gardens enhancing the cottage feel, while the meticulously landscaped front yard showcases a mix of mature and new greenery. A must-see for those who embrace uniqueness!
